Class ControlState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.gameLogic.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.gameLogic.ControlState
class ControlState extends GameState
State implementation that handles the control, validation, and orchestration logic immediately following a player's card pick phase.

This class acts as a state router within the State Pattern of the game framework. It evaluates player pick balances across different board rows (Top/Bottom, Character/Building), processes extra picks (such as wasAdditionalPick and special abilities), handles player totem rotations on the OffersPath, updates turn orders, and safely decides whether the game should prompt the next eligible player or transition toward round or game termination.

  • Method Details

    • controlPick

      protected void controlPick(Game context, boolean wasAdditionalPick, Card card, int rowChosen) throws SQLException
      Executes the primary control cycle after a player attempts or completes a card pick.

      The routine evaluates the pick under two main flows:

      • Additional Pick Flow: Instantly finalized and routed to update models if the choice stems from a temporary additional placement condition.
      • Standard Round Flow: Dynamically reads player totems on the track, checks affordable buildings or pickable characters via custom constraints, shifts turn counters, and computes whether control remains with the current player or moves down the turn queue.
      Overrides:
      controlPick in class GameState
      Parameters:
      context - the central Game orchestrator managing rules and states
      wasAdditionalPick - true if this step covers an extra top pick; false for regular drafts
      card - the targeted Card artifact involved in the action
      rowChosen - the row index where the selection was performed
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database or state persistence error occurs during state transitions

    • nextState

      protected void nextState(Game context) throws SQLException
      Shifts control dynamically into the next state destination based on internal decision flags.

      If goToEndRound evaluates to true, counters reset and control shifts to either EndGameState (if round limit 10 is hit) or a generic EndRoundState. Otherwise, loops context access smoothly back to a standard PickState.

      Specified by:
      nextState in class GameState
      Parameters:
      context - the tracking Game driver instance
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a subsequent transaction context mapping encounters failures
